name: OpenAQ
tagline: Global air quality measurements from public sensors
description: OpenAQ is a public API that aggregates real-time and historical air quality measurements from government and research-grade sensors worldwide. Developers can query locations, parameters (PM2.5, PM10, O3, NO2, etc.), latest measurements, and sensor metadata for environmental apps, research, and monitoring.

auth.details: API key via X-API-Key header; free self-serve key from OpenAQ Explore after account signup

pricing.free_tier_limits: 60 requests/minute, 2,000 requests/hour (free/general tier); higher limits available via custom paid contact

rate_limits: 60 requests/minute and 2,000 requests/hour per API key (free/general use); 429 when exceeded; custom higher limits available
use_cases: get latest PM2.5 readings near a city
list air quality monitoring locations in a country
fetch historical measurements for a sensor
query global air quality by parameter
find sensors within a bounding box
